import numpy as np
# Select baseline points near 1100 and 1800 cm-1 (+/- 10)
m_1100 = (x >= 1090) & (x <= 1110)
m_1800 = (x >= 1790) & (x <= 1810)

if m_1100.sum() > 0 and m_1800.sum() > 0:
    # Calculate average intensity at these points for baseline endpoints
    y_base_1100 = np.mean(y1[m_1100])
    y_base_1800 = np.mean(y1[m_1800])
    
    # Create linear baseline across the entire x range
    baseline = np.interp(x, [1100, 1800], [y_base_1100, y_base_1800])
    
    # Subtract baseline
    y1 = y1 - baseline
    
    # Normalize to G band max (1550-1620 cm-1)
    mask_g = (x >= 1550) & (x <= 1620)
    if mask_g.sum() > 0:
        g_max = np.max(y1[mask_g])
        if g_max != 0:
            y1 = y1 / g_max
else:
    print('Warning: Baseline points not found')
